q: Do we count fuel burned while commissioning or testing new equipment?
title: Fuel burned in trials and testing
short: Yes. Fuel burned in equipment you control is Scope 1 whatever the purpose: commissioning a boiler, test runs of a furnace or engine trials. If the supplier ran the trial with their own fuel, it is their emissions, so check who paid for and controlled the fuel.
audience: MSMEs installing new boilers, furnaces or gensets

ul: Your fuel, your equipment, your site: your Scope 1.
Supplier's fuel during a trial they run: their emissions.
Fuel you pay for that the supplier burns for you: yours.

p: Note trial fuel separately. It explains a spike in the month and keeps it out of your per-unit intensity if no output was made.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.
